name: 91978 · Spring Valley, CA
findings: ZIP 91978 (Spring Valley) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91978 (Spring Valley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91978 (Spring Valley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
